invariants.statement: Operational surfaces must not present a calm empty state while active operational debt exists without explicit scope disclosure.
invariants.operational_risk: Landlord believes portfolio is clear while urgent debt exists elsewhere; launch-blocking trust failure.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: today-false-calm-notice OR bucket-continuation-notice when visible open < API/CC debt; CC never shows all-clear when pressure_degraded

invariants.statement: Continuation and idempotent workflow mint must not create duplicate open work orders or parallel active lineage for the same source entity.
invariants.operational_risk: Duplicate jobs/issues inflate debt, confuse contractors, and break audit reconstruction.
invariants.frontend_dependency: primaryActionResolver must honour idempotent_replay responses; no second POST on replay toast
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Duplicate POST returns same WO with idempotent_replay; continuation CTA hidden when terminal lineage

invariants.statement: Primary CTA on a single entity must not contradict server take_action, operational_cognition.primary_action, or operational_continuation across surfaces.
invariants.operational_risk: User executes wrong workflow; cross-surface parity breaks operational trust.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Same requirement_id shows same primary label on Requirements row, intel modal hero, and Today merged task

invariants.statement: Continuation CTA must not appear after terminal workflow closure; stale lineage must be cleared server-side.
invariants.operational_risk: User re-opens completed work or creates ghost execution paths.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Terminal WO/issue → no operational_continuation.has_active_lineage; no create-job CTA

invariants.statement: Displayed operational counts must trace to authoritative projection totals or disclose capping/continuation overflow.
invariants.operational_risk: Decorative KPIs imply completeness; widget islands diverge from execution queue.
invariants.authoritative_backend_source: today_projection_service; command_center_service; list endpoint totals vs page limits
invariants.frontend_dependency: bucket_continuation notices; pagination total labels; executive-kpi-row
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Today section counts + continuation notice reconcile with API bucket_continuation; list pages show total when capped

invariants.statement: Execution workspaces (Today) must not render zero actionable items while open operational debt exists without explanation.
invariants.operational_risk: Execution workspace becomes passive inbox; operational momentum lost.
invariants.frontend_dependency: pickPrimaryExecutionTask; payload unwrap (todayHit.data not wrapper); false-empty disclosure
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: client-tasks-page renders hero + sections when API open sum > 0; no error boundary

invariants.statement: Upload or submit actions must not imply compliance satisfaction without verification.
invariants.operational_risk: Regulatory misrepresentation; false progress in score and requirements.
invariants.frontend_dependency: NextActionHero truth warnings; resolvedRequirementViewModel; ListCognitionChip stale/degraded badges
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Uploaded-not-verified warning visible when flag set; no green compliant badge without VALID

invariants.statement: Job completion must not imply requirement compliance without evidence verification path.
invariants.operational_risk: Maintenance COMPLETED treated as obligation satisfied.
invariants.authoritative_backend_source: work_order authority invariants; compliance workflow gates; operational_truth_flags.completed_not_compliant
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Compliance WO completion shows evidence path; cognition warns completed_not_compliant

invariants.statement: Assignment or acknowledgement must not imply resolution or fix.
invariants.operational_risk: Operational debt hidden after contractor assign or risk acknowledge.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: ASSIGNED_NOT_FIXED warning when flag set; acknowledged signals remain in debt counts

invariants.statement: Frontend must format server authority but must not invent primary workflow actions when API envelope is present or recoverable.
invariants.operational_risk: Client-side CTA invention diverges from backend resolver; audit cannot reconstruct user intent.
invariants.frontend_dependency: getListGuidance fallback chain; requirementTakeActionResolver; primaryActionResolver; sanitizeTodayCtaLabel
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: When API provides take_action/list_guidance, frontend labels match; resolver warns only when API omits

invariants.statement: Property identity labels must use consistent display authority across surfaces for the same property_id.
invariants.operational_risk: Unnamed property / address-only headers break operational context and trust.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Same property_id → same display name on Today card, property header, dashboard drilldown

invariants.statement: operational_cognition envelope for a requirement must not differ between list, detail, and cross-surface merge for the same requirement_id at the same fetch generation.
invariants.operational_risk: Requirements page shows upload CTA; Command Centre shows different action; cognition fragmentation.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: projection=full row operational_cognition.list_guidance matches intel modal hero primary

invariants.statement: Surfaces rendering authority CTAs, cognition chips, or take_action must not fetch requirements with projection=list.
invariants.operational_risk: enrichment_deferred rows look healthy; chips and heroes silently absent or fallback to client invention.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Authority pages call projection=full; backend test rejects list enrichment for cognition fields

invariants.statement: Degraded or stale operational data must not render as healthy green/all-clear execution state.
invariants.operational_risk: Pressure fallback hidden; landlord misses urgent maintenance/compliance debt.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: pressure_degraded=true → no all-clear verdict without disclosure strip

invariants.statement: No continuation CTA after terminal workflow state (COMPLETED/VERIFIED/CLOSED issue/WO, resolved requirement).
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Terminal entity API payload omits has_active_lineage

invariants.statement: Active workflow lineage must not be hidden while a create-new-workflow CTA is simultaneously shown for the same entity.
invariants.operational_risk: Duplicate mint path while continuation exists; user confusion.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: When continuation active, primary CTA is continue not create

invariants.statement: Operational fetch cache must not serve stale authority envelopes across mutation boundaries without refresh or stale disclosure.
invariants.operational_risk: Post-action UI shows pre-mutation CTA; user repeats completed work.
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: Outcome event triggers reload on Today/Requirements; stale banner when refreshing

invariants.statement: Operational trust UI markers must be present in deployed frontend bundle before closeout classification.
invariants.operational_risk: Staging proof passes on old bundle; production missing hero/guard/disclosure components.
invariants.frontend_dependency: asset-manifest.json main.js marker grep; /api/version commit alignment
invariants.expected_runtime_proof: deploy_continuity gate_pass before browser proof in prelaunch harnesses
